content: Previous studies have been focused on collecting data about sexism and racism in very broad terms or have proposed two categories of sexism as benevolent or hostile sexism BIBREF0, which undermines other types of online harassment. However, there is no much study focusing on different types online harassment alone attracting natural language processing techniques.
